facts.fact: Lesotho's ICT ministry principal secretary said at a closing workshop session that establishing an independent Data Protection Authority must be prioritised.
Lesotho's ICT ministry principal secretary spoke of the need to reform Lesotho's Data Protection Act of 2011 to align it with the AU Convention, SADC Model Law and EU GDPR.
Lesotho's ICT ministry principal secretary said that establishing an independent Data Protection Authority must be prioritised to build trust and ensure enforcement.
